ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7); coach the driver that the "I'm Here" tap must be preceded by continuous waiting in the pickup zone — waiting time before the tap does not count toward the 3-minute no-show threshold (A3).
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: the only messages are pickup logistics and a cancellation notice [F9][F10][F12]; no threats, harassment, sexual remarks or dangerous-driving allegations. safety_concern = none.

The dispute enters NS via NS-0: cancelled_by = driver and the driver asserts rider no-show [F4][F12], so NS-1 governs.

NS-1 requires (i) an "I'm Here" tap or platform arrival confirmation, (ii) the driver within 200 m of the pickup at that moment, and (iii) MORE THAN 3 minutes of continuous waiting in the pickup zone after that tap, with pre-tap loitering excluded.

(i) and (ii) are satisfied: the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 13:02:35 while 39 m from the pickup point, and the platform had also recorded arrival at 13:01:00 [F6][F5].

(iii) fails. After the 13:02:35 tap the driver stayed within 200 m for only 2 min 55 s [F6], i.e. ≤ 180 s, before cancelling at 13:05:30 [F4]. The driver's "more than 3 min already" [F10] and written statement [F12] count the 3 min 15 s stationary period beginning 13:02:15 [F3] and the cumulative 4 min 30 s within 200 m from 13:01:00 [F2][F5] — but all of that pre-dates the tap. A3 requires the waiting to follow the arrival indication ("Is at the pick-up location according to GPS data AND has waited for more than 3 mins"), so pre-tap time cannot be substituted. The rider's own account (out "a minute after" the cancellation) is consistent with the driver never having given the full 3 minutes after indicating arrival.

The chat record is complete and every message is timestamped [F11], so the missing-precondition is established on the record rather than by a gap in evidence; no GPS dropout affects the 13:02:35–13:05:30 window [F3][F6].

Because NS-1 (iii) is not met, NS-2 applies: the $6.61 cancellation fee is refunded in full, refund_full, $6.61 [F7]. No flag_account: the arrival tap at 39 m was inside the pickup zone [F6], so NS-2's fraud limb (tap outside the zone) is not triggered. RD-6 is not engaged — this is a no-show case, no upheld route deviation, and after the refund no RD-1 breach is recorded for this fare. Weather fair and no incidents are irrelevant to a no-show [F13][F14][F15]; the driver's profile record (1 upheld no-show in 90 d) does not decide this case and only ever bears on a flag, which is not warranted here [F17].

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's statement that he waited more than 3 minutes after pressing 'I'm Here' is contradicted by the system timeline: the tap was at 13:02:35 and cancellation at 13:05:30 gives only 2 min 55 s within 200 m after the tap [F6][F4].

Chat message 'More than 3 min already' counts the 3 min 15 s stationary period that began at 13:02:15, i.e. before the arrival tap; per NS-1 (iii) pre-tap waiting does not count toward the no-show threshold.
